facts.fact: Ooredoo Fintech Tunisie announced it obtained the Central Bank of Tunisia's authorisation to launch the walletii digital wallet, as reported by THD from the company communique.

TUN.note: Document states nothing on consumer protection.
Document states nothing on cross-border payments.
Document states nothing on government payments.

facts.fact: Ooredoo Fintech Tunisie says it has the central bank's authorisation to officially launch walletii by Ooredoo, a wallet for bill payments, transfers and cash withdrawals, per THD.

TUN.note: Bill payments are not stated to include taxes or fees.
